corrections.old_text: ዮሐ ፡ ፲፰ ፥ ፴፯ ። ቈላ ፡ ፲፰ ። ቆላ ፡ ፩ ፥ ፲፰ ።
corrections.corrected_text: ዮሐ ፡ ፲፰ ፥ ፴፯ ። ቍ ፡ ፲፰ ። ቆላ ፡ ፩ ፥ ፲፰ ።
corrections.reason: The printed citation abbreviation after John 18:37 is 'ቍ ፡ ፲፰ ።' (ቍጥር 18, i.e., verse 18), not 'ቈላ'.
In Classical Ge'ez grammar, the feminine noun 'ፍጥረትኒ' takes the 3rd person feminine singular pronominal suffix '-ሃ' ('ለፈጣሪሃ' = her Creator), which is clearly printed on the page.
The proverbial Amharic verb is in the 3rd person masculine singular perfective 'በወረወረ' (1st order ረ), matching the printed glyph without a 6th-order top-left notch.
Parallel to 'አንድ በወረወረ', the rhyming verb is 'ሽሕ በመከረ' (1st order ረ), as visibly printed on the page.
The canonical Ge'ez text of Revelation 1:8 and the immediate commentary on line 10 ('አልፋ ፡ ኦ ፡ እኔ ፡ ነኝ') confirm the 7th-order 'ወኦ' (Alpha and Omega).
